notes.title: From the creator of Ghost Trap: Vanquish The Eternal
notes.content: [p]Just in time for Halloween 2025, step into the world of [b]Vanquish The Eternal[/b]. In this action roguelite the mightiest among the living have been brought to the underworld by the King of the Damned! He seeks to absorb your soul and gain your strength. You must survive until midnight against an onslaught of enemies, and vanquish the King of the Damned in order to return to your lands, a hero.[/p][p][/p][p]Featuring 8 fully voiced characters, [/p][p]21 NG+/Difficulty levels, [/p][p]And an array of abilities, talents, and buffs to aid you in your fight! [/p][p][/p][p]You can watch the trailer here:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="LEEU1999oDs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]And you can wishlist it on steam, here: [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3564270/Vanquish_The_Eternal/" style="button"]WISHLIST VANQUISH THE ETERNAL[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
